tools.name: compare_lanes
tools.description: Compare ocean carriers serving an origin→destination port pair, ranked by on-time reliability and transit time. Use this to decide which line to book. With Navo Tokens this costs 10 tokens per call; an empty answer is free.

tools.name: carrier_reliability
tools.description: On-time performance and delay distribution for a specific carrier (by SCAC). With Navo Tokens this costs 10 tokens per call; an empty answer is free.

tools.name: get_schedules
tools.description: Published forward sailing schedules on an origin→destination lane: carrier, vessel, voyage, ETD/ETA, cut-offs and routing (leg count, transshipment ports, distance, CO2 per TEU and the port-by-port route_legs where the carrier publishes them; null where they do not), soonest first, from each carrier

tools.name: find_best_sailings
tools.description: Decision query: the best upcoming sailings on a lane, ONE per carrier (next bookable departure), ranked. Filter by date window, max transit days, min on-time reliability, cut-off still open, and direct-vs-transshipment. Use this to answer "what should I book?". etd, eta, cutoff.at and the from/to wi

tools.name: watch_lane
tools.description: Watch a lane for schedule alerts (PAID): get emailed when a sailing on it is blanked, a booking cut-off is about to close, or a sailing slips. Also alerts on reliability drops. Returns the created watch. Free with Navo Tokens: a watch is configuration, not data.

tools.name: carrier_league
tools.description: Carrier league table: ocean carriers ranked by overall on-time reliability across all tracked lanes. With Navo Tokens this costs 10 tokens per call; an empty answer is free.

tools.name: port_congestion
tools.description: Fused port-congestion signal for a port (UN/LOCODE): effective level (mild/moderate/severe), expected added wait in days (for ETA-band widening), a 0–1 confidence, and the independent readings behind it: measured vessel waiting times, port-call throughput and AIS wait/density.
